# `silk/http/server_native`

<!-- Generated by silk doc-reference. Do not edit by hand. -->

Accepts native socket connections and serves each one with `silk.http.server`.

## When to use
Make a listener with `silk.net.socket_native`, then call `serveNext` in a loop. Each call accepts
one connection and serves it with your `ConnectionHandler` until the handler returns.

## Details
`serveNext` serves one connection at a time, on the calling task. This module has no queue,
router, supervisor, or background task. To serve connections at the same time, start tasks
yourself.

## Errors
- `NativeSocketError` if the accept fails or the deadline passes.
- `ServerError`, `BufferError`, and `OutOfMemoryError` from `silk.http.server`.
- The error of the handler.

## Gotchas
The module exists on Windows x86_64 with the system runtime, Darwin on x86_64 or aarch64, and
Linux with GNU libc on x86_64 or aarch64. On other targets, an import from it fails to compile.
